title: Broker request
description: A request for one allowlisted action. digest is the sha256 of the canonical JSON of {action, actor, target, params, tlp} (tlp only when present); approvals bind to it, so any change after approval is detectable (homelabnext.broker.request_digest). 1.1 adds tlp (additive, optional; ADR-0033 decisions 4 and 6): the label of the data the params were derived from, set by the reader-to-actor handoff (homelabnext.agent.handoff.build_request) from the reader's ceiling, the pack's label and any marker in the output; a request without it is unlabelled (read as red where a label is needed).

tlp.description: The TLP label of the data the params were derived from (1.1). Canonical spelling only.
